Child Policy
• Child sharing (6 – 12 years old) Maximum 1 child with 2 adults: As per rate grid

3rd Adult Policy - Add 40% on Double Rate
ALL INCLUSIVE FORMULA
Welcome drink. In room mini fridge, coffee and tea making facilities. Breakfast, lunch and dinner served at the CRC Restaurant. Fins and Waves bar are open from 10:00 am to 11:00pm and serves soft drinks, fruit juices, coffee and tea, local beer, house wine and
selected cocktails. Snacks are offered between 11am-12pm and 4pm-5pm. Wifi Internet in all rooms and public areas. Fitness and gymnastic activities, padel court, table tennis, billiard, beach volley, non-motorized water sports, soft animation and evening
entertainment program with local shows. Coco Jumbo Kids Club. Daily beach and pool towels. Sunshades, sun loungers by the pool and on the beach. Christmas & New Year lunch and dinner special programs.

pages.text:
PREMIUM ALL INCLUSIVE FORMULA
Express check in. Late check out subject to availability. Welcome drink on arrival. Full room service included at no extra charge for all meal options. Premium selection of branded spirits, beer and wine. Reserved sunbeds with drinks service
Premium All Inclusive is bookable only for adults (above 18 years). The supplement needs to be booked for all adults sharing the room and for the full stay.
The supplement is not subject to any special offer or early booking discount. Minimum nights required: 4
HONEYMOON AMENITIES Flowers decoration, fruit basket in the room upon arrival,
Wedding certificate is required. Valid within 6 months from wedding date. Valid for stay with minimum 3 nights
BIRTHDAY AMENITIES On the day of celebration: flowers decoration in the room, birthday cake
ANNIVERSARY AMENITIES On the day of celebration: flowers decoration in the room, Anniversary Cake
Early Check in/ Late Check out Policy Cancellation Policy
Check In Time 12:00 HRS • All booking cancellations must be advised in writing to the reservations team: rsv@dianireef.com.
Check out Time 10:00 HRS • No refund will be issued for any cancellation made within 7 days before the check-in date.
• Early check in 8Hrs and below 50% of room rate • A 50% refund will be issued if cancellation is made between 8-30 days before check in date.
• Early check in more than 8hrs 100% of Room rate • A full refund for cancellation effected 31 days and above before check-in date.
• Late check out before 18:00Hrs 50% of room rate • During festive season, any cancellation made within 31 days of arrival will incur 100%
• Late check out after 18:00Hrs 100% of Room rate charge of the entire booking.
Payment Policy Minimum Stay
• The payment must be received on confirmation of booking and not later than 7 days prior the • Required minimum stay of 3 nights during festive season.
arrival/check-in date. • Check out will not be permitted on 24th and 31st Dec 2027.
• Bookings not secured by the appropriate deposit will be released automatically and without
prior notification.
• All payments made by cheque must be cleared before the arrival/check-in date. In the
event, a cheque is returned by the bank as "unpaid" for any reason the agent shall replace
the payment by cash and additionally agrees to pay the returned cheque fee thereof.
• The agent agrees to pay any costs, including legal fees, court costs, and any other expenses
incurred by Diani Reef Beach Resort in the collection of unpaid invoices, returned cheques, or default
payment.
